body.text: I write in my official capacity, which I should like you to notice, because I have not done so before.
The Treasury will honour what you pledge in your next {param:turns} letters. After that it honours nothing you have written, whatever you have written, and to whom.
I would use them, if I were you. I am not, and I say that as the kindest thing available to me.
I have carried a great many of your letters. This is the last one I shall enjoy carrying.
I have carried a great many of your letters, and I shall miss carrying them. Not as much as you will miss having them carried, but a little.
It gives me no pleasure. I want that on the record, since very little else of mine is.

tone.text: I have your letter, and I receive it {choice}.

options.text: as a man who intends to use the time
rather worse than you will imagine
with the contempt its author has earned
as the final service of a man I shall not miss

steps.prompt: What the court is to be told

options.label: promise economy, and mean it
options.text: The colony will retrench, and you may put your name to that.

options.label: grant the Chancellor a favour for his trouble
options.text: You have carried more than was owed. It shall be repaid in kind.

grant_favor.favor: a word in the right ear

options.label: say nothing to the court
options.text: The court may think what it likes. It generally does.

tone.hateful: Yours, and not for much longer,
